notes.subject: האבות
notes.rationale: אוב (plural here) is a rare word; from a hollow-sounding water-skin — one who mumbles, a necromancer calling the dead.

notes.subject: אוב / ידעני
notes.rationale: Pairing of two distinct terms for diviners — 'mumbler' and 'knower' — collapsed into one 'medium' in many versions; both kept separate here.

translation: Na Shemuel i dai pinis, na olgeta Yisrael i kirap singsing ren long em, na ol i planim em long Rama, long taun bilong em. Na Shaul i rausim ol mama ol lain bilong toktok wantaim ol man i dai pinis, na ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong save samting hambak, ol i rausim ol i go ausait long graun.
